query: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding rounds announced or reported in June-July 2026, and any imminent/expected funding rounds in July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of what I found on OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding for the June–July 2026 window:

**Key finding:** None of the three announced a *newly closed* equity round within June–July 2026. Instead, the window is defined by IPO pivots (OpenAI, Anthropic) and one imminent private round (Mistral).

**OpenAI** — Last closed round: **$122B at $852B post-money** (Mar 31, 2026, SoftBank co-led). In June–July, focus shifted to its **IPO** (confidential S-1 filed ~May 22/June 8, 2026; Goldman Sachs/Morgan Stanley leading; Q4 2026 target). No new private round in the window.

**Anthropic** — Last closed round: **$65B Series H at $965B post-money** (May 28, 2026), briefly making it the world's most valuable AI company. In June–July, pivoted to **IPO**: confidential S-1 filed June 1, 2026, and roadshow investor outreach began ~July 15, 2026, with a possible October 2026 debut. No new private round in the window.

**Mistral AI** — The clearest *imminent* round: in talks since **June 12, 2026** to raise **~€3B ($3.5B) at ~€20B ($23B) valuation** — nearly doubling its €11.7B Sept 2025 Series C. Still unconfirmed/unclosed as of the mid-July data cutoff.

Full prose report, structured key facts, sources, and data points have been delivered via the StructuredOutput tool. Note: AskNews was unavailable (billing error), so findings rely on web search and direct source fetches; some round-timing dates vary by source (announcement vs. close vs. aggregator dating).
